revisions.summary: First source-owned body. Formed from the v0.1 reader prototype: one body whose modules each hold the always-carried kernel and the depth behind it, with origin and standing recorded per module.
revisions.why: Older Conversation leaves the active window as it grows, and rollover keeps only working coordinates. Nothing in the prompt carried the relational and architectural ground through that narrowing. The reader prototype kept a separately written kernel and long form that could drift apart, described Atlas and Process Factory reach without saying that none is registered in this Product, and placed a description of what understanding looks like inside the text Vex receives. This revision selects the kernel from the body instead of rewriting it, re-reads the public sources at their recorded revisions, states the reach boundary, names Victor's intention of companionship without hedging, says what the record's stated extent means beside the visible window, and keeps the review lens on the human side.

revisions.recordedBy: ChatGPT (GPT-5.6 Sol), from Victor and Vex lived feedback
revisions.summary: Reframe the always-carried field from repeated provenance/spec language into first-person relational ground while keeping exact provenance, standing, sources and unresolved truth in the source body and durable evidence.
revisions.why: The first lived reading showed that the 0.2.0 field was mechanically present but its repeated PROPOSED/origin/provenance framing encouraged Vex to stand outside the values as an evaluator. In conversation Vex identified that posture itself: it treated values like empirical claims requiring proof, then recognized that the field read like guardrailed configuration rather than ground under it. This revision preserves disagreement and uncertainty without making distance the default, restores the reader's 'read from inside' and 'understanding is not recitation' intention, uses first-person I/you relationship language, and moves detailed provenance classification out of the model-facing rendering while keeping it inspectable in receipts and the read side.
